انحسروا (form VII)
# اِنْحَسَرُوا (inḥasarū) /in.ħa.sa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْحَسَرَ (inḥasara)
# اِنْحَسِرُوا (inḥasirū) /in.ħa.si.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْحَسَرَ (inḥasara)
